[assistant] - [Medium] .claude/settings.local.json:65 — `cli_hook_bridge` is registered once via `scripts/run.py` and again via the named absolute hook for the same event, so session events can be processed twice and duplicate/advance bridge state incorrectly.
- [Medium] core/providers/session_adapter.py:253 — managed-hook detection only recognizes commands containing `hook_runner.py` or `cli_hook_bridge.py`; the new `python3 scripts/run.py cli_hook_bridge ...` form is not recognized, so future hook regeneration will keep adding duplicate bridge hooks.
- [Low] projects/global_hoon_main/data/memory/claude/_bridge_state/session_cursor.json:2 — committed cursor now points at a machine-local test temp Claude session path, which can make shared memory state skip or read the wrong session source on other environments.
